title: Price Protection on Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders — Basis Q&A
content:
**Clause.** Where the program's price protection period is above 0, a lower vendor price on the same item offered by Ridgeline within that many calendar days after the order date is credited to the Ridgeline Special Order Services order as the difference, once, as a price adjustment credit, provided the order has not been cancelled or returned; the customer must ask for it, and an order priced under a ProBuild volume quote earns no price adjustment.

## Questions answered by the clause

**What is credited?** The difference between the order price and the lower vendor price Ridgeline offered on the same item, once per order, as a price adjustment credit.

**Does the credit post without a request?** No. The customer must ask for it.

**Which lower prices count?** A lower vendor price on the same item, offered by Ridgeline within the program's price protection period in calendar days after the order date.

**Which orders never earn it?** An order in a program whose price protection period is 0, an order that has been cancelled or returned, and an order priced under a Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards volume quote.

## Examples (hypothetical program with a 14-day period; order placed 1 February at 400.00)

| Situation | Price adjustment |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline offers the same item at 370.00 on 6 February; the customer asks | 30.00, once |
| Ridgeline offers the same item at 370.00 on 25 February | none — outside the period |
| the order was priced under a ProBuild volume quote | none |
| the order was cancelled before the customer asked | none |
